translation: In the conditions of injury with swelling and pain, this is pain caused by the congealing of stagnant blood. If it is distended and heavy and sagging, the color is sometimes blue-black, and in severe cases there is fever, thirst, and sweating, this is obstruction and stagnation of the channels, and injury to the yin blood. One should first prick out the evil blood to open the obstruction, and afterward use Four Substances Decoction (四物湯) to regulate it.
